ledger_results.rule: Last pre-tax-year closed accounts; mandatory consolidation; permitted reserve adjustments
ledger_results.reason: Article 7a(3), across printed pages 4–5, supplies last closed accounts before holder tax-year start, commercial-law consolidation and permitted equity/result deductions for unrecorded tax-permitted reserves. Guide preserves these gates.

ledger_results.rule: Proof of different market value exception
ledger_results.reason: Article 7a(2)(a) permits departure when taxpayer proves ordinary valuation is not market value. Guide requires proof rather than giving an elective preference.

ledger_results.rule: Independent transfer price while economic position not materially changed
ledger_results.reason: Article 7a(2)(b) makes independent-party actual purchase price market value while economic situation has not materially changed; Guide carries both conditions.

ledger_results.rule: Operating trade/industry/service company weighted value (2E+S)/3; formula visually checked
ledger_results.reason: Personally inspected the printed page 34 formula image: U=(2E+S)/3 for operating trade, industry and services. Formula and operating classification match.

ledger_results.rule: Remove article54 shareholder/nonbusiness values and capitalised earnings, then restore asset values in full
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 34 removes shareholder/non-business assets from substance weighting and corrects earnings for their capitalised net result, then restores the asset pool once. Guide and positive-earnings control do this.

ledger_results.rule: Minimum60% operating substance plus100% shareholder/nonbusiness assets
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 34 minimum is 60% operating substance plus 100% shareholder/non-business asset pool, not 60% of total assets. Guide and asset control use that distinction.

ledger_results.rule: Current earnings weighted twice, prior once, divided3; formula visually checked
ledger_results.reason: Personally inspected printed page 34 earnings formula: (2R(n)+R(n-1))*0.85/(3K). Current/prior weights and denominator match.

ledger_results.rule: 15% risk reduction; earnings after nonbusiness expense corrections; negative earnings value0
ledger_results.reason: Printed pages 34–35 combine 0.85 risk factor with commercial net results corrected for non-business expenses. Guide separates adjusted R and capitalised E.

ledger_results.rule: Negative earnings value zero
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 35 expressly sets negative earnings value to zero; Guide max(0,...) and negative-result control match. This is an E floor, not a blanket S floor.

ledger_results.rule: Annualise non12month accounts; new companies substance until representative earnings
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 35 annualises any non-twelve-month period and uses substance until new-company results are representative; Guide preserves both.

ledger_results.rule: Authority can adjust exceptional or fundamentally changed results
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 35 permits authority adjustment for fundamentally changed activity or materially exceptional results, to obtain representative values; Guide does not give taxpayer an unrestricted adjustment election.

ledger_results.rule: 20% capitalisation for FMA supervised regulated financial institutions/services;15% others
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 35 capitalisation rate is 20% for regulated financial institutions/service providers under FMA supervision and 15% for all other legal persons. Guide and FMA control match.

ledger_results.rule: Substance = after-appropriation equity + participation hidden reserves + taxed hidden reserves; formula visually checked
ledger_results.reason: Personally inspected printed page 35 formula image: S=EK+SRB+SR. EK is after profit appropriation; participation hidden reserves and taxed hidden reserves are distinct additions.

ledger_results.rule: Lookthrough participation valuation, carrying-value floor
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 35 requires underlying unquoted-company interests valued under A(1) and carrying value retained when higher. Guide correctly retains this floor.

ledger_results.rule: Holding,finance,property,liquidating,inactive companies substance method
ledger_results.reason: Printed pages 35–36 Annex B uses A(3) substance for holding, finance, property, liquidation and inactive companies. Guide does not route all such companies to earnings weighting.

ledger_results.rule: Banks/insurers not finance companies under B exception
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 36 excludes financial institutions, particularly banks and insurers, from B finance companies. Guide keeps this exclusion separate from FMA rate selection.

ledger_results.rule: Voting-right basis; C expressly applies to A value; private agreements disregarded
ledger_results.reason: Printed page 36 C refers specifically to A company value and voting-right share; private contracts are disregarded. Guide separates capital economics from voting and does not automatically extend C to B.

ledger_results.rule: Below20% votes discount20%;20inclusive–50exclusive discount10%;50inclusive0
ledger_results.reason: Personally inspected printed page 36 voting table: <20% ->20%, >=20% and <50% ->10%, >=50% ->0%. Exact 20% and 50% control boundaries match.

ledger_results.rule: Official2026 helper1January2026/31December2025 calendar accounts instructions
ledger_results.reason: Independently read original native OOXML shared strings A1/A3: 2026 title, 1 January 2026 date, 31 December 2025 calendar accounts, last preceding closed accounts and twelve-month annualisation. No cached-result inference used.

ledger_results.rule: Helper company rounding100 inP44/P57; not finaltaxrounding authority
ledger_results.reason: Independently read native formula text P44=ROUNDDOWN(P43,-2), P57=ROUNDDOWN(IF(W56=0,V62,AB27),-2). Guide labels these as helper company rounding, not statutory total-wealth or final-tax rounding.

ledger_results.rule: Helper F70 feeds economic allocation G70 and voting discount lookup J70; separate legal facts if unequal
ledger_results.reason: Independently read native formulas G70=$P$57*F70 and J70=LOOKUP(F70,U83:W85), K70 applies returned discount; lookup thresholds 0/.2/.5 give .2/.1/0. Guide identifies the single-input limitation and requires separate economic/voting facts.
